chunks.title: Fully Automatic Series
chunks.content: The Fully Automatic PAWM series features Artificial Intelligence wash and 'Brain Technology' (resumes exactly where it stopped after power failure). Models with an 'i' (900i, 1100i) feature a Smart Touch panel, while non-i models use Soft Touch. Specs: 10 water levels, tempered glass with damper. PAWM 900/900i consume 380W Wash/260W Spin. PAWM 1100/1100i consume 420W Wash/280W Spin.

chunks.title: Semi Automatic Series
chunks.content: The Semi Automatic PWMS series uses a manual water inlet and features an Anti-Rust body, Big Pulsator, Rat Guard Base Plate, and Gear Train Technology (reduces direct motor load). PWMS 8050 consumes 350W, and PWMS 1250 consumes 450W.
